caption: The drawing depicts a single ceramic cup placed against a plain, light beige background. The cup has a rounded body, a wide rim, and is fixed to a thick base, which appears slightly irregular in shape and wider than the cup itself. The handle is attached on the right side and curves downward, connecting to both the upper portion and the base. The surface of the cup and base is glazed with a variegated pattern consisting of green, brown, yellow, and some hints of blue and maroon blotches, giving it a mottled appearance. The drawing is centered on the paper, and a faint rectangular outline near the edges frames the composition. There are no additional objects or background details within the frame.
title: Shaving Mug
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
